properties.name: turing.ai.enabled
properties.description: Enable or disable AI features including generative AI and semantic search capabilities.

properties.name: turing.ai.crypto.key
properties.description: AES/GCM encryption key used to encrypt and decrypt AI provider secrets (API keys, credentials). Must be set in production; falls back to a development key if empty.

properties.name: turing.allowedOrigins
properties.description: Comma-separated list of allowed CORS origins for cross-origin requests.

properties.name: turing.elasticsearch.timeout
properties.description: Connection timeout in milliseconds for Elasticsearch operations.

properties.name: turing.jms.concurrency
properties.description: JMS listener concurrency range for the indexing queue in 'min-max' format (e.g., '1-1'). Controls how many concurrent consumers process document indexing jobs.

properties.name: turing.keycloak
properties.description: Enable or disable Keycloak integration for authentication and authorization.

properties.name: turing.keycloak-admin-id
properties.description: Keycloak user ID that is automatically granted the Administrator group on every application startup.

properties.name: turing.storage.type
properties.description: Storage backend type: 'none' (default, no storage), 'minio' (MinIO object storage), 'filesystem' (local filesystem at turing.storage.path).

properties.name: turing.storage.filesystem.path
properties.description: Base directory for filesystem storage. Only used when turing.storage.type=filesystem. Default: ./store/assets

properties.name: turing.storage.minio.endpoint
properties.description: MinIO server endpoint URL (e.g., http://localhost:9000).

properties.name: turing.storage.minio.access-key
properties.description: Access key (username) for authenticating with the MinIO server.

properties.name: turing.storage.minio.secret-key
properties.description: Secret key (password) for authenticating with the MinIO server.

properties.name: turing.storage.minio.bucket
properties.description: Name of the MinIO bucket used to store application assets (e.g., 'turing-assets').

properties.name: turing.marketplace.enabled
properties.description: Enable or disable the Marketplace feature, which allows browsing and importing pre-built packages from an external catalog.

properties.name: turing.marketplace.url
properties.description: URL of the external marketplace catalog JSON. When the external URL is unreachable, falls back to the bundled sample catalog.

properties.name: turing.mongodb.enabled
properties.description: Enable or disable MongoDB integration for logging and data persistence.

properties.name: turing.mongodb.uri
properties.description: MongoDB connection URI string (e.g., mongodb://localhost:27017).

properties.name: turing.mongodb.logging.database
properties.description: MongoDB database name used for storing application logs.

properties.name: turing.mongodb.logging.collection.server
properties.description: MongoDB collection name for storing general server application logs including errors and stack traces.

properties.name: turing.mongodb.logging.collection.aem
properties.description: MongoDB collection name for storing Adobe Experience Manager (AEM) connector integration logs.

properties.name: turing.mongodb.logging.collection.indexing
properties.description: MongoDB collection name for storing search indexing operation logs including document status and results.

properties.name: turing.mongodb.logging.purge.days
properties.description: Number of days to retain MongoDB logs before automatic purging. A scheduled daily task deletes logs older than this threshold.

properties.name: turing.multi-tenant
properties.description: Enable or disable multi-tenant mode for supporting multiple isolated tenants.

properties.name: turing.open-browser
properties.description: Automatically open the default web browser on application startup.

properties.name: turing.openai.key
properties.description: OpenAI API key for accessing generative AI and LLM services.

properties.name: turing.permissions
properties.description: Enable or disable the fine-grained permissions system. When disabled, all authenticated users receive full admin privileges.

properties.name: turing.search.cache.enabled
properties.description: Enable or disable caching for search query results.

properties.name: turing.search.cache.ttl.seconds
properties.description: Time-to-live in seconds for cached search results before expiration.

properties.name: turing.search.engine.type
properties.description: Search engine type to use (e.g., 'solr', 'elasticsearch').

properties.name: turing.search.metrics.enabled
properties.description: Enable or disable collection of search performance metrics.

properties.name: turing.solr.cloud
properties.description: Enable SolrCloud mode for distributed search across multiple nodes.

properties.name: turing.solr.commit.enabled
properties.description: Enable or disable explicit Solr commits after indexing operations. When disabled, relies on Solr auto-commit settings.

properties.name: turing.solr.commit.within
properties.description: Maximum time in milliseconds before a soft commit is triggered in Solr.

properties.name: turing.solr.timeout
properties.description: Connection timeout in milliseconds for Solr operations.

properties.name: turing.url
properties.description: Base URL of the Turing application (e.g., http://localhost:2700).

properties.name: turing.authentication.thirdparty
properties.description: A description for 'turing.authentication.thirdparty'

properties.name: turing.git.server
properties.description: A description for 'turing.git.server'

properties.name: turing.authentication.new-user
properties.description: A description for 'turing.authentication.new-user'
